steps: Mix dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves) in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat sweet potato puree, yogurt, egg, olive oil, and honey/maple syrup until smooth.

caption: Sweet Potato Apple Muffins 🍠🍎🍁 These freeze really well :)  2 cups flour  3 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 1.5 teaspoon ground cinnamon ½ teaspoon ground ginger Pinch of ground nutmeg Pinch of ground cloves 1 cup baked sweet potato puree 3/4 cup plain yogurt 1 egg + 1 yolk  3 tablespoons olive oil 1/2 cup maple syrup or honey 🍯  1 cup diced apple Streusel Topping (optional but recommended): ¼ cup packed brown sugar ½ cup flour 2 tablespoons butter, melted Instructions  •Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin. •Mix dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves) in a large bowl. •In another bowl, beat sweet potato puree, yogurt, egg, olive oil, and honey/maple syrup until smooth. •Make a well in dry ingredients, pour in wet mixture, stir gently until just combined (don't overmix). Fold in diced apples. ( I like to let my batter sit for 20 minutes here to hydrate the flour)  •Mix streusel: brown sugar + flour + melted butter. •Fill muffin cups ⅔ full. Sprinkle each with streusel. •Bake 5 minutes at 425, then reduce heat to 350 and bake for 15 or until golden and springy. #fallbaking #momof3 #toddlersnacks #fallrecipes
